Shale Network welcomes conversations with community monitoring groups, researchers, government agencies, industry, and river commissions that hold water-quality observations from regions of oil and gas development.

## Tell us about the dataset

A short description is enough to begin. Please include:

- the geographic area, water types, sampling dates, and measurements;
- the available file formats and accompanying laboratory or field documentation;
- who collected and owns the data, and whether sharing permission is established;
- any access restrictions, embargo needs, or sensitive locations.

The team will discuss the data and an appropriate transfer route with you. Please do not send confidential reports, personal information, or protected site coordinates through the form. See [data-use and contribution guidance](data-use-and-embargo-policy.qmd).
